verdict.rationale: While Loops exposes API endpoints for contacts, events, and campaign content (loops-docs-3, loops-docs-4, loops-docs-6), and mentions segments only as a dashboard feature that stays dynamic (loops-docs-16), there is no documented endpoint or MCP tool for creating or defining an audience segment programmatically from a natural-language description. No evidence shows an agent can translate plain-language criteria into a real segment via the API or MCP surface.
